title: Arular
notes:
Some copies came in a die-cut slipcase (M.I.A. letters).

Track 1: Title as "Banana Skit" on the back sleeve.
Track 3: Inspired by [url=http://www.discogs.com/artist/477716-MC-Deize-Tigrona]Dayse Tigrona's[/url] "Injecao", produced by DJ Marlboro. Incorporating elements of "Theme From Rocky" written by Conti/Robbins/Connors.
Track 12: Contains a sample from "Sanford And Son Theme/The Streetbeater", performed by [a17546]. Originally produced and mixed by KW Griff licensed from Quiet Records.
Track 13.2 is unlisted. It starts at the 3:53 point of track 13 (which is 7:22 long).
